summary: Frontend-only verification of Staff Dashboard header/menu reorganization. Logged in as cristina.velez@brasillacrosse.com (admin). Header renders cleanly with the new Menu button; the staff-menu-popover opens and contains all three sections (Monitoring, Reports, Communication) with all 12 expected items. Every navigation item routed correctly to its expected /staff/* route; all three modal items (CMJ Day, Daily Report, Export) opened a visible dialog. Persistent controls (admin-panel-btn, staff-bell-btn, logout-btn, profile photo link) are present and working. Team/Athlete/Season filters remain functional. No regression observed in the header.

integration_issues.issue: Transient 'Failed to load dashboard data' toast + multiple 500 errors from readiness range endpoint appear in console on /staff. Pre-existing / unrelated to header change per handoff note, but readiness chart area stays blank.
affected_selectors: Daily Readiness Score by Athlete chart

action_items: (Pre-existing, out of scope for this header change) Investigate 500 errors on the readiness range API causing the 'Failed to load dashboard data' toast and empty readiness chart on /staff.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffDashboard.js is very large (>2400 lines) - consider splitting header/menu/modals into separate components for maintainability.

profile-btn is only rendered when user has no profile_photo; the avatar image path uses a wrapping Link but no data-testid, so tests targeting 'profile-btn' must fall back to the photo link. Consider adding data-testid='profile-photo-link' on the <a> for consistency.
